rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary: adopted 16 December 2014, promulgated 9 January 2015, Official Gazette 9 June 2015; regulator CMIL set up by Decree 2023-1541 but not fully operational; DLA Piper notes no implementing decree published so application is not yet effective.

rules.source: Loi n° 2014-006 sur la lutte contre la cybercriminalité, amended by Loi n° 2016-031 — https://www.coe.int/web/octopus/-/madagascar
rules.retrieved_snippet: Council of Europe Octopus page (search summary): lists Law 2014-006 on Combating Cybercrime and Law 2016-031 of 23/09/16 modifying it; covers information-system offences, content offences and service-provider liability; RSF reports Constitutional High Court upheld it and criticises provisions on defaming officials online.
